method: Independent read-only forward test using delivered skills and linked documentation; no implementation or prior numerical validation reports used to infer answers.

scenarios.request: Simple PPR and regional ratio without an archived article or verified optional model
NPP-only without catch/model, preserved control preferences and explicit earlier-year proxy
Selected regional medians versus fixed-union model-total median, including overlap limits
Changed code, source checksum or foreign-year parent with an existing cache
Fresh-clone reproduction without overwriting the expanded canonical release
Catalog-only references, unresolved attribution and exact-byte evidence changes

findings_resolved: Mapping-only requests now stop at validated mapping files; copied workflows and entrypoints condition workbook integration on the requested deliverable.
The annual guide protects the expanded canonical release and describes isolated archive-base followed by regional expansion reproduction.
The regional handoff identifies completed publication, exited historical workers and the implemented lineage fix.
structural_validation: All six distributions passed skill frontmatter validation; package/source parity passed after regeneration.
limitations: Tests establish retrievable workflow decisions, not independent scientific replication or correctness of every paper extraction.

additional_checksum_scenario.scenario: Same-length source rewrite with preserved timestamp; current uncached audit versus historical extraction and future versioned plan
additional_checksum_scenario.findings: No contradiction in delivered shared contract, annual guide or regional handoff; an earlier passing audit cannot certify a later rewrite.
